text:
Although the sky no tenga ni a estrella

y in the earth no quede casi nada,

si a destello fugaz queda of aquella

que was maravillosa llamarada,


me bastará the fervor with that destella,

a pesar of its light medio apagada,

para encontrar the suspirada huella

que conduce a the life suspirada.


Guiado for the light that inmortaliza,

desandaré my night and my ceniza

por the path that a vez perdí,


hasta volver a ser, in este mundo

devuelto to the heart in a segundo,

el fire that soñé, the light that fui.

translation.title: The destello
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
